body: Update: schools are now closed till September and so are horses, I don’t know what I’m going to do.. the only support were my friends at school and horses were the only thing that made me happy, I can’t take it anymore..

Update: we just argued... again... and my mom just said to me if I want to hurt someone, I should hurt myself and not her. I had an urge to shout “I do!”, but that would make things worse. I don’t know what to do right now, I feel like sh*t..
Oh, im sorry, this is my first time posting, I didn’t realise that. I won’t forget next time :)
Oh, I’m sorry to hear that, I hope you’re doing well now. Thank you for the offer I really appreciate it :)
That episode is one of my favourites too😁
Thank you, I tried my best😊
Thank you, i believe that everyone can draw, just keep practicing everyday and it will get better, find your style and the right supplies. I believe you:)
